Falla de válvula anti-hielo

Questions and answers

What is Falla de válvula anti-hielo?

In this glossary, Falla de válvula anti-hielo refers to: Malfunction of wing or engine anti-ice valve preventing hot-air flow, compromising ice protection and requiring flight profile adjustment.

How is Falla de válvula anti-hielo used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Aproximación, NOVA seis uno, falla de válvula anti-hielo; no podemos activar deshielo de alas, solicitamos menor altitud."

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

Malfunction of wing or engine anti-ice valve preventing hot-air flow, compromising ice protection and requiring flight profile adjustment.

Operational example

Approach, NOVA six one, anti-ice valve failure indicated; unable to activate wing anti-ice, request lower altitude.

Localized term

Falla de válvula anti-hielo

Localized example
